fi-rhinecanthus-aculeatus.title: Humu Humu Picasso Triggerfish
rows: About 10 in (LiveAquaria max size); wild record 30 cm (11.8 in) TL (FishBase)
Carnivore. Squid, krill, clams, small fish and hard-shelled shrimp to wear down its teeth
Indo-Pacific: East Africa eastward through northern Australia to Hawaiian, Marquesas and Tuamotu islands, north to southern Japan
